svg.aria-label: Engineering student at UTBM, on a work-study apprenticeship at Électricité de Strasbourg: half my week is spent in the energy sector, where power grids, data and the energy transition meet. I'm into AI agents. I write skills, MCP servers and multi-agent workflows, and I work with agents every day. The rest of the time I build web apps that work offline, and whenever an exam is coming up, I build myself a tool to revise for it. I also have a soft spot for China: its cities, the street life, the metro at rush hour, the Huangpu at night.
